section_summary.extract_value: This discussion section summarizes the findings of the present study (Study X), which investigated the association between positive body image (body appreciation and body image flexibility) and sexual liberalism/unconventional sexual practices in an online sample of US adults. The study found significant associations, often with gender differences (e.g., technology liberalism in men but not women, BMI effects in women but not men), and discusses these in the context of previous research, suggesting implications for understanding the role of positive body image in sexual liberalism. It also highlights the need for further examination of the factor structure of the SLS scale.
